name: Kozec SEO
author: tyvanroy

sections.description:
Kozec SEO is the official WordPress integration for the Kozec platform. It serves as a bridge between your WordPress site and your Kozec account, enabling seamless synchronization of SEO metadata and content settings.

While Kozec provides a powerful premium web service for content management and optimization, this plugin ensures that your WordPress data remains perfectly in sync. It exposes SEO plugin meta fields to the REST API, allowing the Kozec platform to read and write SEO data programmatically.

Why Use This Plugin?

If you use Kozec to manage your content strategy, this plugin is essential. It allows Kozec to:
* Read existing SEO metadata from your WordPress posts.
* Update SEO titles, descriptions, and focus keywords directly from the Kozec dashboard.
* Ensure your content strategy is reflected accurately on your live site.

Supported SEO Plugins

Kozec SEO works by integrating with your existing SEO plugin. We support:
* Yoast SEO (Free & Premium)
* Rank Math SEO
* SEOPress
* All in One SEO Pack
* The SEO Framework
* Squirrly SEO

Features

  • Seamless Integration: Connects your WordPress site to the Kozec ecosystem.
  • Zero Configuration: Just activate it, and it works.
  • Secure: Uses standard WordPress authentication (requires edit_posts capability).
  • Lightweight: No admin pages, no database bloat.

REST API Endpoints

  • GET /wp-json/kozec/v1/status – Returns plugin status and configuration
  • GET /wp-json/kozec/v1/seo-plugins – Detects which SEO plugins are installed
sections.installation:
1. Upload the kozec-seo folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. That’s it! Your site is now ready to connect with Kozec.

Via WordPress Admin

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New.
  2. Search for “Kozec SEO”.
  3. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”.
sections.faq:
Is this a standalone SEO plugin?

No. This plugin acts as a bridge. You still need a dedicated SEO plugin (like Yoast or Rank Math) installed on your WordPress site to handle the actual SEO logic. Kozec SEO simply makes that data accessible to the Kozec platform.

Do I need a Kozec account?

This plugin is designed to work with the Kozec premium service. While it technically exposes SEO data via REST API for any use, its primary purpose is to integrate with Kozec.

Is authentication required?

Yes. Only authenticated users with the edit_posts capability can read or write SEO meta fields. This ensures your data remains secure.
